cohort: 166 pregnant women in their third trimester of their second pregnancy, with a history of one previous cesarean section, attending a clinic in Northern Jordan. Women with an absolute indication for cesarean section were excluded.
finding: Fear of pain was the most common reason for choosing ERCS, and being informed about the complications of TOLAC was significantly associated with choosing TOLAC.
mod_finding: The choice of TOLAC was almost four times higher for those participants who had been informed about the complications, compared to those who had not been informed.
